context: A uni student catches up with his teen friend at the cafe
purpose: Teach: 美人/こども/さっぱり/またまた/そこそこ/あらためて/かたち/気配

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 久しぶり!なんかロングヘアになって、すっかり美人姉妹の妹って感じだな。
lines.en: Long time! You've grown your hair out — you really look like the younger sister of a beautiful pair now.
lines.style: Warm casual greeting with light teasing tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: またまた、お世辞やめてよ。お兄ちゃんこそ大学生になって、なんかそこそこ大人っぽくなったね。
lines.en: There you go again, stop flattering me. You yourself got kind of grown-up since starting uni.
lines.style: Teen pushback playful but slightly embarrassed delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あらためて見ると、もうこどもじゃないんだなって思うわ。この前まで一緒にドット絵のゲームやってたのに。
lines.en: Looking at you properly, I realize you're not a kid anymore. We were playing pixel-art games together not long ago.
lines.style: Nostalgic gentle reflection by older friend

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それ気にしてたの?私もう高校生だよ。アップルの新しいタブレットで絵描いたりしてるし。
lines.en: You were worried about that? I'm in high school now. I draw on the new Apple tablet and stuff.
lines.style: Proud teenage assertion of growing independence today

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、すごいな。俺なんか課題のレポートでさっぱり進まなくて、締め切り前なのに人の気配がない図書館に籠ってるよ。
lines.en: Wow, impressive. Meanwhile my report isn't progressing at all — I'm holed up in an empty library near the deadline.
lines.style: Self-deprecating university student complaint about deadlines

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 何のレポート書いてるの?
lines.style: Short curious follow-up question from teen

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 市場メカニズムについて。理屈はわかるんだけど、どういうかたちでまとめるか悩んでて。
lines.en: About market mechanisms. I understand the theory, but I'm stuck on what shape to give the conclusion.
lines.style: Thoughtful academic explanation given to younger friend

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 難しそう。でもお兄ちゃんなら絶対書けるよ。コーヒーおごるから頑張って。
lines.en: Sounds tough. But you can definitely write it. I'll buy you a coffee, so hang in there.
lines.style: Encouraging supportive younger-sister-figure tone, tone matching the moment with quiet honesty
